note: "text" is what appears in captions. "say" (optional) is the phonetic version sent to the TTS engine so Lynkk is pronounced "link". Every claim must be backed by lynkk-post-kit/docs/TRUTHS.md.

lines.text: Hi, I'm Ava from Lynkk.
In this tutorial, you'll learn three ways to record a Microsoft Teams meeting with Lynkk, and what you get when the call ends.
lines.say: In this tutorial, you'll learn three ways to record a Microsoft Teams meeting with Link, and what you get when the call ends.

lines.text: First, the problem.
Someone has to remember to press record. And depending on your company's settings, guests often can't start a recording at all.
Even when you do record, you get an hour of video that nobody has time to rewatch.
And the decisions and action items stay in someone's head.

scenes.chapter: Three ways to record Teams with Lynkk

lines.text: Lynkk gives you three ways to record a Teams call.
lines.say: Link gives you three ways to record a Teams call.

lines.text: A meeting bot that joins from the link.
The Mac app, where nothing joins the call.
And the Chrome extension, if you use Teams in your browser.
Whichever you pick, the note comes out the same.
Step one: go to lynkk.ai and start free.
lines.say: Step one: go to link dot A I, and start free.

lines.text: The free plan includes recording and transcripts, the meeting bot, the Meeting Brief, and tasks.
Way one: the meeting bot.
Paste your Teams meeting link into Lynkk, or turn on calendar auto-join, and the bot joins the call for you.
lines.say: Paste your Teams meeting link into Link, or turn on calendar auto-join, and the bot joins the call for you.

lines.text: If the meeting uses a lobby, admit it like any other guest.
While it records, you can follow a live transcript. On the free plan the bot records audio. Video recording is Pro.

scenes.chapter: Way 2: The Mac app, no bot

lines.text: Way two: the Mac app.
Start your Teams call as usual. After a few seconds, a card appears in the top right: Microsoft Teams call detected. Click Record.
No bot joins the call. Lynkk records both sides on separate channels, so the transcript knows which words are yours.
lines.say: No bot joins the call. Link records both sides on separate channels, so the transcript knows which words are yours.

lines.text: A slim column on the edge of your screen shows the clock, the levels, and the live words.
When the call ends, Lynkk saves the recording by itself. The Mac app is free to install on Apple silicon Macs.
lines.say: When the call ends, Link saves the recording by itself. The Mac app is free to install on Apple silicon Macs.

lines.text: Way three: the Chrome extension.
Open your Teams meeting in a Chrome tab. A small capsule docks above the call controls. Press Record.
Again, no bot. Lynkk records the tab's audio and your mic. It also works in Edge, Brave and Arc.
lines.say: Again, no bot. Link records the tab's audio, and your mic. It also works in Edge, Brave, and Arc.

scenes.chapter: After the call: the Meeting Brief

lines.text: When the call ends, every recording becomes a note.
You get a transcript with speaker labels, in seventeen languages.
And a Meeting Brief: key takeaways with timestamps, decisions, open questions, and action items with an owner and a due date.
Click any timestamp to play the recording from that moment.
Action items land on your task board.
When you're ready, send them to Jira from the note: one issue per action item, in the project you pick.
On Pro, you can ask Lynkk questions across your notes.
lines.say: On Pro, you can ask Link questions across your notes.

lines.text: For example: what did Acme say about the rollout date?
Lynkk answers only from your own notes, with sources, and plays the moment it was said.
lines.say: Link answers only from your own notes, with sources, and plays the moment it was said.

lines.text: Sales and customer teams get a brief for every call, with next steps and owners.
Product and engineering teams send decisions and tasks to Jira.
On back to back days, connect Google Calendar for a morning email: who you're meeting, and what's still open.
Global teams get transcripts in seventeen languages.
For in-person meetings, record your mic in the browser at lynkk.ai.
lines.say: For in-person meetings, record your mic in the browser, at link dot A I.

lines.text: And small teams can share a workspace of up to ten seats, where everyone gets Pro.
Quick recap.
The meeting bot: paste the Teams link, or turn on auto-join.
The Mac app: click Record when the call card appears.
The Chrome extension: press Record in the tab.
Every call becomes a note, with a brief and tasks you can send to Jira.
Record your next Teams meeting with Lynkk.
lines.say: Record your next Teams meeting with Link.
